# Webgram IT Solution

> Webgram IT Solution is a web development company based in Sangam Vihar, New Delhi, India. Founded in 2019 by Vikas Kumar, the company specializes in ecommerce website development, B2B commerce platforms, WooCommerce development, Shopify development, marketplace development and custom web portals for businesses across India and internationally.

## Company

- Name: Webgram IT Solution

- Website: https://webgramitsolution.com

## Services

- Ecommerce website development (WooCommerce, Shopify)
- B2B commerce platforms with MOQ, RFQ, wholesale pricing and customer groups
- Multi-vendor marketplace development
- Custom web portal development
- Website design and development
- API integration
- Website maintenance and support

## Areas Served

- Delhi, South Delhi, Sangam Vihar
- Noida, Gurgaon, Faridabad
- Delhi NCR
- Pan India
- International (Canada and other countries)

## Technologies Used

- WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify
- React, Next.js, Node.js
- PostgreSQL, Supabase
- Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree
- WhatsApp API, Shiprocket, GoKwik
